subject.title: [Feature]: Add bounded Memory Wiki batch operations for automation

question: Should Memory Wiki expose supported, versioned batch apply/search CLI contracts for automation, or should callers continue composing the existing single-operation commands?
rationale: The requested commands add a durable public automation contract and must define failure, atomicity, query-scope, and JSON compatibility semantics; source and documentation review cannot choose that policy safely without plugin-owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor bounded plugin commands
options.body: Define plugin-owned batch manifests, limits, JSON schemas, and mutation/query semantics, then implement them with focused compatibility and concurrency coverage.

options.title: Keep composition external
options.body: Retain the current single-operation CLI contract and document the supported automation composition pattern rather than adding new batch APIs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded plugin commands
recommendation.body: Define plugin-owned batch manifests, limits, JSON schemas, and mutation/query semantics, then implement them with focused compatibility and concurrency coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related Memory Wiki mutation-safety work is the strongest available signal for the vault coordination contract this decision would extend.
